learning_outcomes.text: Students learn methods and technical expertise for the complete processing of design tasks for complex and novel machines and products.

syllabus_topics: Design of components and assemblies for manufacturing and assembly suitability
Design of components and assemblies for force flow and stress suitability
Procedure and technical documentation for complex and innovative machine development
Definition of requirements for construction tasks
Conception of simple to moderately complex machines
Constructive design of simple to moderately complex machines
assessment_rules: The graded written exam for MABB330 has a duration of 120 minutes. The weighting of the examination components is MABB331 : MABB332 : MABB333 = 1 : 1 : 0. The study performance for the Construction Exercise 1 (MABB333) is an ungraded semester-long study project worked on in small groups, which must be passed but does not contribute to the module grade. Active participation in the project and several milestone meetings, as well as submission of a final report, are mandatory for MABB333.
bibliography: Wittel, H. et al.: Roloff/Matek Maschinenelemente – Normung, Berechnung, Gestaltung. Springer 2017
Pahl, G.; Beitz, W.: Konstruktionslehre – Methoden und Anwendung erfolgreicher Produktentwicklung. Springer 2013
